title: Are most people here oneironauts ?
content: "Oneironaut" is a term for a person who travels through dreams in a conscious state, also known as [oneironautics](https://www.google.com/search?sca_esv=26e890c59c598073&sxsrf=AE3TifM4PEXq9mkeIhcP9hdQ361ov3cwfQ%3A1762228769389&q=oneironautics&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwic37_ezdeQAxX4IkQIHdTUA5YQxccNegQIGxAC&mstk=AUtExfA_FgUSSbgXap9KcHmaQalNgeqs8p5qizapsCVw235mqbiNosydAXaRKR-fWOR08BS1RZ0DYkf2t-K_JK9ZAsfhdO6nLde5l_otnSXSagQfqy4cz8KYK1oCCMyzMdGCKRSWaap0Lb5Xmt3t2cXevz19f_S7AKR8qeZZUfPyU7tJzFaimsmsanMcslWDBl8Wt3rbfRFBksSHCGv7MMNrGL6DzLnfCOtGnvB0MKAnKphSXtmmUnS3R8aE-lsk1tJngYUBDBBX-qOmG9KtOxLqUn9t&csui=3). The term is used in various contexts, including a theory of precognitive dreams, a board game, a book, and an album title. Dreaming is the most fascinating and bizarre experience that I've had throughout my life, and my connection to dreams seems to be part of my purpose in this earthly realm. I've had a great number of anomalous experiences related to dreaming that started from a young age, and it was actually my interest in lucid dreaming that led me down rabbit holes that led to other spiritual experiences: I've been lucid dreaming since I was 4 years old. Often they involve flying although there was a period of time when I remember learning how to fly in the dream world. Like the ability was blocked or I could only sustain it for short bursts. After some point I have been able to fly consistently and without much effort. Even to escape from scenarios or dreams that I dislike I find that I can now just simply fly away. Starting at age 3-4 I had recurrent lucid dreams that would happen every single night. A large number of these dreams involved a evil clown character that would try to trap me in the dream realm. If I was facing towards my left, I would be vulnerable, if i was to my right I was somehow safe. In the dream I would wake up and I would be in my room but it would be slightly off, it was start spinning faster and faster until I was so dizzy I could hardly make any sense of anything and then the clown man would come out of the ceiling and take me into his realm where I would be in some kind of virtual reality. I barely remember what he would do to me anymore since I was so young when this was happening. I've been having precognitive dreams since I was 7 years old. I will literally dream about an exact scenario and then it will come true usually the next day although sometimes it will take some time. I've had several experiences of being "abducted" while in a lucid dream. I'll be in my bed and its like my soul is getting beamed up. Only thing I can compare it to is doing DMT and having your soul exit your body. Except instead of going into some kind of spirit world its like im going upward. and then everything goes black and next thing I heard is the aliens talking in a alien language saying "put him back now in his body, we're done here". Mallworld is one of several dreamscapes that I am familiar with. I have been to these locations: the movie theater- it definitely has a back stage to it. The infinite mall area. The boardwalk/docks with the food stands, the infinite brothel (im not sure this is part of mall world though but many people here have mentioned interacting with this space). In about 10 percent of my dreams, I exist within the harry potter universe. and its not as if im a huge potter head. I watched the movies as a kid, thats it. But to this day I am often having dreams where I am on the run from the death eaters, dueling back and forth with spells , flying on a broom stick etc. Ive never been in any other fictional universe. Once I had a dream where I was something like a humanoid praying mantis, and I recalled this to be my "true body". It was as if I had forgotten who I was. And I was finally home in my original body with my original appendages/thorax/coloration. It was unlike any dream I have ever had before.
